name: RVDP virtual display
description: Streams the device's LVGL screen over WebSocket as the routeOS Virtual Display Protocol, with optional pointer and keyboard control. Viewers: Termz, ShareScreen, any browser.

status.notes: Compiled into the Orbit HMI image. Measured on the lab board: about 150 KB of heap (LVGL pool, tile queue, draw strip). Not tested alongside BLE provisioning.
